import numpy as np, re, os, json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(gin):
    A=np.array(gin)
    fr=[]
    for c in sorted(set(map(int,A.flatten()))-{0}):
        ys,xs=np.where(A==c)
        y0,y1,x0,x1=int(ys.min()),int(ys.max()),int(xs.min()),int(xs.max())
        fr.append((y0,x0,int(y1-y0+1),int(x1-x0+1),c))
    t=max(fr,key=lambda b:b[4]*b[2]*b[3])
    ty0,tx0,th,tw,tc=t
    tp=A[ty0:ty0+th,tx0:tx0+tw]
    out=np.zeros_like(A)
    for y0,x0,h,w,c in fr:
        if (y0,x0)==(ty0,tx0): continue
        if (h,w)!=(th,tw): continue
        out[y0:y0+h,x0:x0+w]=np.where(tp==tc,c,0)
    out[ty0:ty0+th,tx0:tx0+tw]=tp
    return out

import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(gin):
    A=np.array(gin); H,W=A.shape
    # find frames: bounding boxes where every nonzero cell belongs to an outline component; detect by checking full rows/cols of c across bbox
    def rect_bbox(c):
        ys,xs=np.where(A==c)
        y0,y1,x0,x1=int(ys.min()),int(ys.max()),int(xs.min()),int(xs.max())
        return y0,x0,int(y1-y0+1),int(x1-x0+1)
    fr=[]
    for c in sorted(set(map(int,A.flatten()))-{0}):
        if c==0: continue
        y0,x0,h,w=rect_bbox(c)
        sub=A[y0:y0+h,x0:x0+w]
        if h<3 or w<3: continue
        # frame: cells along top/bottom/left/right within bbox mostly c AND interior contains some other color cells OR border gaps
        top_ok = (sub[0,:]==c).sum()>0 and (sub[-1,:]==c).sum()>0
        left_ok = (sub[:,0]==c).sum()>0 and (sub[:,-1]==c).sum()>0
        # patterned frame = one whose interior has nonzero cells (template) 
        inter=(sub[1:-1,1:-1]!=0).any()
        if top_ok and left_ok and (inter or (sub[1:-1,1:-1]==c).all()):
            fr.append((y0,x0,h,w,c))
    templ=max([f_ for f_ in fr if (A[f_[0]:f_[0]+f_[2],f_[1]:f_[1]+f_[3]][1:-1,1:-1]!=0).any()], key=lambda f_: f_[2]*f_[3]) if len(fr)>0 else None
    if not templ: return out=None
    ty0,tx0,th,tw,tc=templ
    tp=A[ty0:ty0+th,tx0:tx0+tw]
    out=np.zeros_like(A)
    for fy,fx,fh,fw,fc in fr:
        if (fh,fw)!=(th,tw): continue
        if (fy,fx)==(ty0,tx0): continue
        out[fy:fy+fh,fx:fx+fw]=tp
    return out.tolist()
for dn in [1,2,3]:
    r=solve(G[f'Demo pair {dn} input'])
    ok=r==G[f'Demo pair {dn} output']
    print(dn, 'exact:',ok)
    if not ok:
        P=np.array(r); Q=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {dn} output'])
        print('shapes',P.shape,Q.shape)
        if P.shape==Q.shape:
            for p in np.argwhere(P!=Q): print(p, P[p],Q[p])
ans=solve(G['Test input'])
print('test shapes ok:', ans is not None and len(ans)==len(G['Test input']))
